lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly refresh of mise.lock, any time on Monday: the daily workflow run does not reliably start before 4am, Renovate's default window

customManagers.description: OCI chart pinned in an app.yaml: `url: ghcr.io/argoproj/argo-helm`, then `chart: argo-cd`, then `revision: 10.11.6`, on consecutive lines

packageRules.description: Commit subjects follow the repository's style: `bump <dependency> to <version>`
Minor and patch bumps of the actions land as one PR; each major gets its own
Minor and patch bumps of the pre-commit hooks land as one PR; each major gets its own
Minor and patch bumps of the tools in mise.toml land as one PR; each major gets its own
The chart's own version (Chart.yaml, the targetRevision in example/clusters/mgmt-1/root.yaml, the --version in README.md) moves only with scripts/release.sh
